description: Change a swatch's options (Swatch Options, from the Swatches panel menu or a swatch's context menu): rename it or name it with its colour values, switch a colour between process and spot, convert it to RGB, CMYK or Lab (Color panel menu), set its values, change a tint's percentage, change a mixed ink's ink percentages, or convert a mixed ink or mixed ink group to process

inks.description: Mixed ink swatches: new percentages for some of its inks

ink.description: Ink name, one of the mixed ink's inks

model.description: Color Type: process or spot (colours); process converts a mixed ink or mixed ink group to process colours

nameWithColorValue.description: Rename the colour from its (final) values, e.g. "R=255 G=0 B=0" (Name with Color Value)

space.description: Color Mode: convert the colour to rgb, cmyk or lab; with values, the space the values are in

swatch.description: The swatch to change, by name

tint.description: Tint swatches: percentage of the base colour

values.description: Colour values in the chosen space: RGB 0-255 each; CMYK 0-100 each; Lab L 0-100, a and b -128 to 127. Needs space

name: edit_swatch
title: Edit Swatch
